pages.text: $(li)Craft a pair of $(l:radiocraft:radios/vhf_handheld)VHF handhelds$(/l): set both to the same frequency and talk.$(li)Then build a $(l:radiocraft:radios/vhf_base_station)base station$(/l) with a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/vhf_antennas)J-pole$(/l) on $(l:radiocraft:antennas/coax)coax$(/l) and $(l:radiocraft:power/overview)power$(/l).$(li)When you want the world, an $(l:radiocraft:radios/hf_radios)HF radio$(/l) and a $(l:radiocraft:antennas/dipole)dipole$(/l).

pages.name: A VHF base station
pages.text: Radio, two blocks of coax and a J-pole. Any length of coax works. Power it too.
